```plato
    // The index of the span containing parameter u, clamped to a real span.
    SpanContaining(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, u: Number): Integer
        => (self.KnotCount - 1).Range
            .Reduce(0, (acc, i) => self.KnotParameter(i) <= u ? i : acc)
            .Min(self.KnotCount - 2)
            .Max(0);
```
